name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.mono
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (a b : ℕ), a ∣ b →
intro l _ X _ _ g a b hab
show: For an endomorphism g of an ℓ-adic module and natural numbers a dividing b, the cokernel of gᵃ−1 has length at most that of gᵇ−1.
strategy: Write b=ak. A geometric sum factors gᵇ−I through gᵃ−I. The image inclusion induces a surjection from the cokernel at b onto the cokernel at a.

steps.claim: Write $b=ak$. The identity $g^b-1=(g^a-1)\sum_{i<k}(g^a)^i$ gives $(g^b-1)X\subseteq(g^a-1)X$, so the cokernel at $b$ surjects onto the cokernel at $a$. Its module length therefore bounds the length at $a$.
steps.snippet:
cokLen (g ^ a - 1) ≤ cokLen (g ^ b - 1) := by
  intro l _ X _ _ g a b hab
  apply cokLen_le_of_range_le
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hab
  rw [pow_mul, ← mul_geom_sum]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
